h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilwara

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilwara

items.pText: Bhilwara in southern Rajasthan is known as a textile city, with many spinning and weaving units on its outskirts. Some of these companies run staff housing, and a few support schools or community spaces in the town. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for factory campuses, schools, housing colonies and parks in Bhilwara at our Vasai factory, about 690 km away, and delivers it by road.

A company buying a playground for an employee colony usually wants something that lasts and needs little attention from a busy admin team. The Mewar region has hot, dry summers, a short monsoon and mild winters. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit that climate well. We share a maintenance schedule at handover, and our after-sales team can be reached on working days if a part needs replacing.

richText.heading: Playgrounds for factory colonies and corporate campuses

c: On a factory campus, place the play area inside the residential zone and well away from loading bays, truck routes and machinery. A boundary hedge or fence with one gate makes it easier to watch children.

items.q: Where should a playground go on a factory campus?

items.q: How much maintenance will our admin team need to do?
items.a: A weekly walk-around and a monthly check of chains, springs, bearings and fixings. We share the steps at handover, and our after-sales team helps with spare parts.
